answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake tokens and form peer-auditing graphs verified by topological cut verifications. A patrolling auditor, alert as a raven, shines an analytical lantern across clustered identities to expose sparse boundaries. If collusion is detected, stake slashing penalizes the cluster, turning the attacker’s staked capital into a barren dune while imposing superlinear costs to forge valid graph cuts.
